`h10-daily.csv` is the Federal Reserve Board's H.10 daily foreign exchange rates, downloaded from
its Data Download Program (https://www.federalreserve.gov/datadownload, release H10, CSV, series in
columns, with labels) on 2026-11-08 (commit 2b1bef0, ducat #114).

Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. Board data is in the public domain; the
Board asks that it be cited as the source.
